'''Malastarian fuel''' was a type of [[Fuel/Legends|fuel]] mined out of the core of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Malastare/Legends|Malastare]]. When the native [[Dug/Legends|Dugs]] began to harvest the fuel, its [[Poison/Legends|toxic]] properties drove Malastare's [[Zillo Beast/Legends|Zillo Beasts]] to near-extinction.<ref name="The Zillo Beast" />

{{Science-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Malastarian fuel first appeared in "[[The Zillo Beast]]," the eighteenth episode of the [[Star Wars: The Clone Wars|''Star Wars: The Clone Wars'' television series']] [[The Clone Wars: Season Two|second season]].<ref name="The Zillo Beast" /> However, it was not identified as such until the publication of the episode's accompanying guide.<ref name="The Zillo Beast Guide">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode218.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: The Zillo Beast}}</ref>
